# Andrea Gigante  - www.skytale.it

> Andrea Gigante is a Principal Product Manager at Oracle NetSuite with 13+ years of
> experience bridging business strategy and technical execution. Based in Málaga, Spain
> (Italian origin). Specializes in AI product development, MCP server architecture,
> security tooling, and waterfall-to-agile transformations across finance, sports betting,
> insurance, and automotive industries.

## About

Andrea Gigante builds real tools alongside his PM career. His open-source projects include
a 62-tool MCP server for AI-assisted personal finance, a multi-agent orchestration system
(AgentGate), a distributed VPN monitoring platform (VPNSentinel), and automated bank sync
tooling. All public work is on GitHub at github.com/agigante80.

The site name "Skytale" (σκυτάλη) references the ancient Spartan transposition cipher  -
representing Andrea's long-standing interest in cryptography and security.

## Pages

## Projects (key entries)

- /projects/actual-mcp-server: MCP server for Actual Budget  - 62 tools, TypeScript, Docker
- /projects/agentgate: Multi-agent AI orchestration via Telegram/Slack, Python
- /projects/vpnsentinel: Distributed VPN monitoring with DNS leak detection, Python/Flask
- /projects/actual-sync: Automated bank sync for Actual Budget, 309 tests, Node.js
